title: WordPress quickstart VERIFICATION.json carries no stand origin or machine path
steps: S1: In vendor/wordpress/tracy-wordpress-theme/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme run: npm ci, then node --test --test-reporter=tap scripts/test/verification-portable.test.mjs scripts/test/quickstart-patch-chain.test.mjs scripts/test/quickstart-cycle.test.mjs
S2: Read the result of each test.
expect: Every test in verification-portable.test.mjs passes: stand origins and machine paths (start of value, inside text, file:// URLs) are absent from the record; a non-loopback IPv6 address and repository-relative paths stay; release, version, gate, visual and hashes are unchanged.
evidence: The JA Restaurant WP release's VERIFICATION.json held http://127.0.0.1:<port> origins and ~/ evidence dirs; published WP releases before it held none.
fence: Skill tooling only; no theme, pack or fleet change.
